content.name: 上海高考口语标准题型

parts.value: Directions: Read aloud the following sentences. For each sentence, you will have thirty seconds to prepare and fifteen seconds to read.
Directions: Read aloud the following passage. You will have one minute to prepare and thirty seconds to read.
Directions: Ask two questions about each situation given below. At least one special question should be asked about each situation.
Begin your talk with the sentence given:
Directions: In Section A, you will hear four sentences. Make quick responses to the sentences you have heard.
Directions: In Section B, you will hear a short passage about

. The passage will be read twice. After you hear the passage, answer the first question with the information you hear and the second in your own opinion with at least 3 sentences. For the first question, you will have 30 seconds to prepare and 30 seconds to talk. For the second question, you will have one minute to prepare and another minute to talk.
Directions: You will have one minute to prepare and another minute to talk about the following pictures with at least five sentences. Begin your talk with the sentence given.
